Nina (Billing): Flagging customer OrbitX — preview 120412 in the portal omitted the "reserved GPU credit" line and a duplicate preview 120412-dup appeared. Final invoice had the line but amounts differ from dashboard. Can backend take a look?
Raj (Backend): Checking logs. preview-generator called usage-merge, got an empty page mid-merge and ended up publishing partial lines. Snippet: `WARN merge: empty page token=pg-9, publishing partial aggregation`
Clara (Ops): We saw intermittent timeouts to usage-store for ~03:15-03:20 UTC which lines up. Might be transient pagination race + retry behavior creates duplicate previews.
InvoiceBot: [job 2044] preview created customer=orbitx preview_id=120412 status=complete
InvoiceBot: [job 2045] preview created customer=orbitx preview_id=120412-dup status=complete
Nina (Billing): OrbitX is withholding payment until we confirm correct numbers. Need estimated delta ASAP.
Raj (Backend): Will patch: (1) treat empty page with next_token as transient and retry up to 3x, (2) only publish preview when aggregated_lines != empty, (3) add idempotency check on preview store. Opening PR now.
Clara (Ops): I'll schedule a hotfix deploy and a dry-run replay for the affected window once PR is merged.
Noah (Finance): I'll prepare a temporary credit offer in case numbers shift. Please attach regenerated PDF and reconciliation CSV to this thread when done.
Nina (Billing): Thanks — please @support once fixed so we can notify OrbitX.
Raj (Backend): PR merged. Deployed. Replay completed, regenerated invoice 120412 attached: total matches usage-store = $2,347.50, reserved credit line present. Duplicate gone.
Nina (Billing): Got it — sending update and offering a $25 goodwill credit. Noah ok?
Noah (Finance): Approved $25. Marking resolved; reopen if customer reports anything else. :white_check_mark:
